name: Grevesmühlen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Grevesmühlen (a bull's head within a cogwheel on yellow).
history: The flag was designed by the Schwerin heraldist Karl-Heinz Steinbruch and approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 5 June 2014.

features.role: Grevesmühlen arms — bull's head in cogwheel on yellow
